definition_en: only on the surface, not deep or thorough
core_image: 只擦掉桌面上的灰，却没有看见桌下的裂痕
scene: 他的伤只是表面的，并不严重。His injury was only superficial and not serious.
sceneCN: 这里 superficial 是「表面的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他的伤只是表面的，并不严重。

senses.title: On the surface only
senses.definition: existing only on the outer layer
senses.example: His injury was only superficial and not serious.
senses.exampleCN: 他的伤只是表面的，并不严重。
senses.why: This is the physical sense.

senses.title: Not deep or thorough
senses.definition: not going deeply into a subject
senses.definitionCN: 没有深入探讨某一主题
senses.example: The report gives only a superficial analysis.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告只做了肤浅的分析。
senses.why: Here the word criticizes shallow thinking.
senses.whyCN: 这里批评的是思考浅薄。

intro.en: Superficial comes from Latin superficies, the surface.
intro.cn: superficial 来自拉丁语 superficies，意为表面。

note.en: Superficial is compared with look-alike words and with words for shallowness.
note.cn: 把 superficial 与形近词以及表示浅薄的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Superficial means staying on the surface and never going under it.
normalIntro.cn: superficial 就是停在表面，从不潜入下面。

normal.en: His injury was only superficial and not serious.
normal.cn: 他的伤只是表面的，并不严重。

normal.en: The report gives only a superficial analysis.
normal.cn: 这份报告只做了肤浅的分析。

normal.en: There is a superficial resemblance between the two.
normal.cn: 两者之间只有表面的相似。

normal.en: Superficial damage is easy to repair.
His knowledge of the subject is superficial.
normal.cn: 他对这个主题的了解很肤浅。

abstract.en: Superficial is a glance pretending to be a look.
abstract.cn: 肤浅，是一瞥假装成凝视。

abstract.en: The surface is true, but it is not the whole truth.
abstract.cn: 表面是真的，但不是全部真相。

abstract.en: Depth begins where the surface stops being enough.
abstract.cn: 当表面不再够用，深度就开始了。

examples.en: His injury was only superficial and not serious.
examples.cn: 他的伤只是表面的，并不严重。

examples.en: The report gives only a superficial analysis.
examples.cn: 这份报告只做了肤浅的分析。

examples.en: Superficial damage is easy to repair.

dict_mnemonic.text: superficial 由拉丁语「在上」与「面」组成，表示只在表面的；引申为知识或分析肤浅的。

root: 来自拉丁语 superficies（表面），由 super（在上）与 facies（面）组成，字面是「最上面的一层」。

sensesIntro.en: Superficial means only on the outer layer, or not deep in thought.
sensesIntro.cn: superficial 表示只在外层，也可指思考或知识不深入。

core.en: Only the top layer of a thing.

branches.en: His injury was only superficial and not serious.
branches.cn: 他的伤只是表面的，并不严重。

branches.en: Superficial damage is easy to repair.
branches.cn: 表面损伤容易修复。

branches.en: The report gives only a superficial analysis.
branches.cn: 这份报告只做了肤浅的分析。

branches.en: A surface wound and a shallow view share one word.
branches.cn: 表面伤口与浅薄观点共用一个词。

branches.en: His knowledge of the subject is superficial.
branches.cn: 他对这个主题的了解很肤浅。

intro.en: Superficial builds superficially and superficiality.
intro.cn: superficial 可构成 superficially 和 superficiality。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin facies, face, with super above.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是拉丁语 facies（面），加上 super（在上）。

items.example: The critic noted the superficiality of the film.
items.exampleCN: 评论家指出这部电影的肤浅。

items.example: The superficialness of the plan worried them.
items.exampleCN: 计划的表面性让他们担心。

items.example: The word superficies is now rare.
items.exampleCN: superficies 这个词现在少见了。

latinEntries.example: Super is the first element of superficial.
latinEntries.exampleCN: super 是 superficial 的第一个成分。

latinEntries.example: Facies is the second element of superficial.
latinEntries.exampleCN: facies 是 superficial 的第二个成分。

latinEntries.example: Superficies led to English superficial.
latinEntries.exampleCN: superficies 演变为英语的 superficial。

definition_en: better than another, or higher in rank
core_image: 两座塔并排，其中一座明显更高
scene: 这种材料在耐用性上优于那种。This material is superior to that one in durability.
sceneCN: 这里 superior 是「更好的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这种材料在耐用性上优于那种。

senses.title: Better in quality
senses.definition: higher in quality than another
senses.example: This material is superior to that one in durability.
senses.exampleCN: 这种材料在耐用性上优于那种。
senses.why: This is the comparative quality sense.

senses.title: Higher in rank
senses.definition: having a higher position
senses.example: Report the problem to your superior officer.
senses.exampleCN: 把问题报告给你的上级军官。
senses.why: Here the word is about rank.

senses.title: Feeling above others
senses.definition: behaving as if better than others
senses.example: He gave a superior smile.
senses.exampleCN: 他露出一种高人一等的微笑。
senses.why: This sense is often critical.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项常带批评意味。

intro.en: Superior is the Latin comparative of super, above.
intro.cn: superior 是拉丁语 super（在上）的比较级形式。

items.en: It also named a person of higher rank.

note.en: Superior is compared with look-alike words and with words for rank and quality.
note.cn: 把 superior 与形近词以及表示等级、质量的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Superior means placed higher, in quality or in rank.
normalIntro.cn: superior 意为位置更高，无论是质量还是等级。

normal.en: This material is superior to that one in durability.
normal.cn: 这种材料在耐用性上优于那种。

normal.en: Report the problem to your superior officer.
normal.cn: 把问题报告给你的上级军官。

normal.en: Their team gave a superior performance.
He gave a superior smile.
normal.cn: 他露出一种高人一等的微笑。

normal.en: Always address your immediate superior first.
normal.cn: 永远先向你的直接上级汇报。

abstract.en: To be superior is a comparison, not a character.
abstract.cn: 优越是一种比较，而不是一种品格。

abstract.en: What is higher can still be cold.
abstract.cn: 更高的东西，也可能是冷的。

abstract.en: Real superiority has no need to announce itself.
abstract.cn: 真正的优越，不需要自我宣告。

examples.en: This material is superior to that one in durability.
examples.cn: 这种材料在耐用性上优于那种。

examples.en: Their team gave a superior performance.
He gave a superior smile.
examples.cn: 他露出一种高人一等的微笑。

dict_mnemonic.text: superior 是「更好的、上级的」，be superior to 表示优于；注意与 to 连用，不用 than。

root: 来自拉丁语 superior（更高的），是 super（在上）的比较级，后引申为质量更好或等级更高。

sensesIntro.en: Superior means better in quality, higher in rank, or behaving as if above others.
sensesIntro.cn: superior 表示质量更好、等级更高，或表现得高人一等。

core.en: Standing higher than another.

branches.en: This material is superior to that one in durability.
branches.cn: 这种材料在耐用性上优于那种。

branches.en: Their team gave a superior performance.
branches.cn: 他们队的表现更出色。

branches.en: Report the problem to your superior officer.
branches.cn: 把问题报告给你的上级军官。

branches.en: He gave a superior smile.
branches.cn: 他露出一种高人一等的微笑。

branches.en: Rank and attitude can look alike from outside.
branches.cn: 等级与态度从外面看可能很像。

intro.en: Superior builds superiority and superiorly.
intro.cn: superior 可构成 superiority 和 superiorly。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin super, above, in its comparative form.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根是拉丁语 super（在上）的比较级形式。

items.exampleCN: 他们证明了自己的优越。

latinEntries.example: Super is the root of superior.
latinEntries.exampleCN: super 是 superior 的词根。

latinEntries.example: Superior entered English as an adjective.
latinEntries.exampleCN: superior 作为形容词进入英语。

definition_en: a large self-service shop selling food and household goods
core_image: 一排排货架之间，顾客推着购物车慢慢走
scene: 她在超市买了水果和牛奶。She bought fruit and milk at the supermarket.
sceneCN: 这里 supermarket 是「超级市场」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她在超市买了水果和牛奶。

senses.title: A large self-service shop
senses.definition: a large shop where customers serve themselves
senses.definitionCN: 顾客自行取货的大型商店
senses.example: She bought fruit and milk at the supermarket.
senses.exampleCN: 她在超市买了水果和牛奶。
senses.why: This is the everyday place sense.

senses.title: A chain of such shops
senses.definition: a company that runs many such shops
senses.definitionCN: 经营多家此类商店的公司
senses.example: The supermarket opened ten new branches.
senses.exampleCN: 这家连锁超市新开了十家分店。
senses.why: Here the word names the business, not one shop.
senses.whyCN: 这里指企业，而不是单家门店。

intro.en: Supermarket joins super, beyond, with market, a place of trade.
intro.cn: supermarket 由 super（超出）与 market（市场）组合而成。

items.en: Market meant a place of trade.
Market meant a public place of selling.
items.cn: market 指公开售货的场所。

items.en: Supermarket meant a very large market.
items.cn: supermarket 指规模很大的市场。

items.en: It spread worldwide as a shop type.
items.cn: 它作为店铺类型传遍世界。

note.en: Supermarket is compared with look-alike words and with other places to shop.
note.cn: 把 supermarket 与形近词以及其他购物场所作比较。

entries.definition: a place where goods are sold

normalIntro.en: A supermarket is a market grown large enough to hold everything.
normalIntro.cn: 超市就是一个大到能装下一切的市场。

normal.en: She bought fruit and milk at the supermarket.
normal.cn: 她在超市买了水果和牛奶。

normal.en: The supermarket opens at eight.
We pushed a trolley around the supermarket.
normal.cn: 我们推着购物车在超市里走。

normal.en: The supermarket chain opened ten new branches.
normal.cn: 这家连锁超市新开了十家分店。

normal.en: The local supermarket hires many students.
normal.cn: 当地超市雇了许多学生。

abstract.en: A supermarket is abundance arranged in rows.
abstract.cn: 超市，是排成行的丰盛。

abstract.en: Everything is within reach, and that is the point.
abstract.cn: 一切都触手可及，这正是它的意义。

abstract.en: We shop quickly and forget how far the food travelled.
abstract.cn: 我们买得很快，却忘了食物走了多远。

examples.en: She bought fruit and milk at the supermarket.
examples.cn: 她在超市买了水果和牛奶。

examples.en: The supermarket opens at eight.
We pushed a trolley around the supermarket.
examples.cn: 我们推着购物车在超市里走。

dict_mnemonic.text: supermarket 由 super（超级）与 market（市场）构成，表示超市；supermarket chain 是连锁超市。

root: 由 super（超级、超出）与 market（市场）复合而成，指规模超出传统市场的大型自选商店。

sensesIntro.en: Supermarket means a large self-service shop, or the company that runs such shops.
sensesIntro.cn: supermarket 表示大型自选商店，也可指经营这类门店的公司。

core.en: A market made large and self-service.

branches.en: She bought fruit and milk at the supermarket.
branches.cn: 她在超市买了水果和牛奶。

branches.cn: 我们推着购物车在超市里走。

branches.en: The supermarket chain opened ten new branches.
branches.cn: 这家连锁超市新开了十家分店。

branches.en: One shop and a whole chain share the name.
branches.cn: 一家店和整个连锁共用一个名字。

branches.en: The supermarket opens at eight.
branches.cn: 超市八点开门。

intro.en: Supermarket combines super and market; market builds marketplace.
intro.cn: supermarket 由 super 与 market 组合，market 还能构成 marketplace。

latinIntro.en: Market comes from Latin mercatus, trade.
latinIntro.cn: market 来自拉丁语 mercatus，意为交易。

latinEntries.example: Mercatus is the source of market.
latinEntries.exampleCN: mercatus 是 market 的来源。

latinEntries.example: Super is the first part of supermarket.
latinEntries.exampleCN: super 是 supermarket 的第一个部分。

definition_en: something added to improve or complete another thing
core_image: 一杯水旁放着一片维生素，补足饮食的缺口
scene: 这种药片是维生素补充剂。This tablet is a vitamin supplement.
sceneCN: 这里 supplement 是「补充物、补充剂」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这种药片是维生素补充剂。

senses.title: Something added
senses.definition: something added to complete or improve
senses.definitionCN: 为补全或改善而添加的东西
senses.example: This tablet is a vitamin supplement.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药片是维生素补充剂。
senses.why: This is the main noun sense.

senses.title: To add to something
senses.definition: to add something to improve or complete
senses.definitionCN: 添加某物以改善或补全
senses.example: She supplements her income with evening work.
senses.exampleCN: 她靠晚间工作补充收入。
senses.why: This is the verb sense.

senses.title: An extra section
senses.definition: an extra part added to a newspaper or book
senses.definitionCN: 报纸或书籍附加的部分
senses.example: The newspaper printed a weekend supplement.
senses.exampleCN: 报纸印了一份周末增刊。
senses.why: Here the added thing is a publication.

intro.en: Supplement comes from Latin supplere, to fill up.
intro.cn: supplement 来自拉丁语 supplere，意为填满、补足。

items.en: Supplement meant a pill or an extra part.
items.cn: supplement 指补充剂或附加部分。

note.en: Supplement is compared with its look-alike complement and with words for additions.
note.cn: 把 supplement 与形近的 complement 以及表示添加物的词作比较。

entries.definition: something added to a main thing

normalIntro.en: A supplement fills a gap that the main thing leaves open.
normalIntro.cn: supplement 补上主要事物留下的缺口。

normal.en: This tablet is a vitamin supplement.
normal.cn: 这种药片是维生素补充剂。

normal.en: She supplements her income with evening work.
normal.cn: 她靠晚间工作补充收入。

normal.en: The newspaper printed a weekend supplement.
normal.cn: 报纸印了一份周末增刊。

normal.en: He takes an iron supplement daily.
The course is a supplement to the main textbook.
normal.cn: 这门课是主教材的补充。

abstract.en: A supplement is a bridge over a small gap.
abstract.cn: 补充物，是架在小缺口上的一座桥。

abstract.en: What completes us is not always what replaces us.
abstract.cn: 补全我们的，不一定是取代我们的。

abstract.en: Good supplements know when to stop.
abstract.cn: 好的补充，懂得何时停止。

examples.en: This tablet is a vitamin supplement.
examples.cn: 这种药片是维生素补充剂。

examples.en: She supplements her income with evening work.
examples.cn: 她靠晚间工作补充收入。

examples.en: The newspaper printed a weekend supplement.
examples.cn: 报纸印了一份周末增刊。

dict_mnemonic.text: supplement 是「补充物」，作动词表示补充；vitamin supplement 是维生素补充剂，supplementary 是补充的。注意与 complement（补全）区分。

root: 来自拉丁语 supplere（填满），由 sub（在下）与 plere（填满）组成，字面是「在下面填满」，引申为补充。

sensesIntro.en: Supplement means something added to complete a thing, the act of adding, or an extra publication section.
sensesIntro.cn: supplement 表示补全某物的添加物、补充的动作，或报刊的增刊。

core.en: An addition that fills a gap.

branches.en: This tablet is a vitamin supplement.
branches.cn: 这种药片是维生素补充剂。

branches.en: She supplements her income with evening work.
branches.cn: 她靠晚间工作补充收入。

branches.en: The newspaper printed a weekend supplement.
branches.cn: 报纸印了一份周末增刊。

branches.en: The thing added and the act of adding share a word.
branches.cn: 添加物与添加动作共用一个词。

branches.en: The course is a supplement to the main textbook.
branches.cn: 这门课是主教材的补充。

intro.en: Supplement builds supplementary and supplementation.
intro.cn: supplement 可构成 supplementary 和 supplementation。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin plere, to fill, with sub under.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是拉丁语 plere（填满），加上 sub（在下）。

latinEntries.example: Supplere is the source of supplement.
latinEntries.exampleCN: supplere 是 supplement 的来源。

latinEntries.example: Plere also gave English complete.
latinEntries.exampleCN: plere 也演变为英语的 complete。

definition_en: to provide something needed, or the amount provided
core_image: 一辆货车把新鲜蔬菜卸到商店门口
scene: 这家农场向本地商店供应蔬菜。The farm supplies vegetables to local shops.
sceneCN: 这里 supply 是「供应」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这家农场向本地商店供应蔬菜。

senses.title: To provide
senses.definition: to give or sell something that is needed
senses.definitionCN: 给出或出售所需要的东西
senses.example: The farm supplies vegetables to local shops.
senses.exampleCN: 这家农场向本地商店供应蔬菜。
senses.why: This is the main verb sense.

senses.title: The amount available
senses.definition: the amount of something available
senses.example: The water supply is limited.
senses.why: Here the word is a noun of amount.

senses.title: Goods for a need
senses.definition: food and equipment needed for a purpose
senses.definitionCN: 为某一目的需要的食物与装备
senses.example: They carried medical supplies.
senses.why: This plural sense names concrete goods.
senses.whyCN: 这个复数义项指具体物资。

intro.en: Supply comes from Latin supplere, to fill up.
intro.cn: supply 来自拉丁语 supplere，意为填满、补足。

items.en: Suppleer meant to fill a need.
It also meant the amount provided.

note.en: Supply is compared with look-alike words and with verbs of providing.
note.cn: 把 supply 与形近词以及表示提供的动词作比较。

entries.definition: to ask formally or to put on

normalIntro.en: To supply is to fill the empty space in someone's need.
normalIntro.cn: supply 就是填满别人需求里的空位。

normal.en: The farm supplies vegetables to local shops.
normal.cn: 这家农场向本地商店供应蔬菜。

normal.en: The water supply is limited.
They carried medical supplies.
Demand is rising faster than supply.
Fresh water is in short supply here.

abstract.en: Supply is a promise made in goods.
abstract.cn: 供应，是用货物许下的承诺。

abstract.en: What is in short supply becomes precious.
abstract.cn: 供应不足的东西会变得珍贵。

abstract.en: A chain of supply is a chain of trust.
abstract.cn: 供应链，也是一条信任链。

examples.en: The farm supplies vegetables to local shops.
examples.cn: 这家农场向本地商店供应蔬菜。

examples.en: The water supply is limited.
They carried medical supplies.

dict_mnemonic.text: supply 是「供应」，也可作名词表示供应量；supplies 指补给品，supply and demand 是供求，supplier 是供应商。

root: 来自拉丁语 supplere（填满），由 sub（在下）与 plere（填满）组成，后经古法语进入英语，表示提供所需。

sensesIntro.en: Supply means to provide something needed, the amount available, or the goods provided.
sensesIntro.cn: supply 表示提供所需之物、可获得的供应量，或所提供的物资。

core.en: Filling a need with goods.

branches.en: The farm supplies vegetables to local shops.
branches.cn: 这家农场向本地商店供应蔬菜。

branches.en: The water supply is limited.
branches.cn: 供水是有限的。

branches.en: They carried medical supplies.
branches.cn: 他们携带医疗物资。

branches.en: The act and the amount share one word.
branches.cn: 供应动作与供应量共用一个词。

branches.en: Fresh water is in short supply here.
branches.cn: 这里淡水供应不足。

intro.en: Supply builds supplier and supplies, and shares a root with supplement.
intro.cn: supply 可构成 supplier 和 supplies，并与 supplement 同根。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin plere, to fill.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根是拉丁语 plere，意为填满。

latinEntries.example: Supplere is the source of supply.
latinEntries.exampleCN: supplere 是 supply 的来源。

latinEntries.example: Plere also gave English complete.
latinEntries.exampleCN: plere 也演变为英语的 complete。

definition_en: to help or hold something up, or to provide for someone
core_image: 两根柱子稳稳托住屋顶
scene: 家人支持她的决定。Her family supported her decision.
sceneCN: 这里 support 是「支持」（第 1 个义项）；句意：家人支持她的决定。

senses.title: To back someone
senses.definition: to help someone or agree with a plan
senses.definitionCN: 帮助某人或赞成某个计划
senses.example: Her family supported her decision.
senses.why: This is the main social sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是主要的社会关系义项。

senses.title: To hold up
senses.definition: to carry the weight of something
senses.example: The columns support the roof.
senses.why: This is the physical sense.

senses.title: Help or a prop
senses.definition: help given, or a thing that holds something up
senses.definitionCN: 给予的帮助，或托住某物的东西
senses.example: The bridge needs more support.
senses.why: This noun covers help and structure.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词涵盖帮助与支撑结构。

senses.title: To provide for
senses.definition: to pay for the needs of someone
senses.example: He supports a family of four.
senses.why: Here support means money and care.
senses.whyCN: 这里指金钱与生活照料。

intro.en: Support comes from Latin supportare, to carry from below.
intro.cn: support 来自拉丁语 supportare，意为从下面承载。

items.en: Supportare meant to carry from below.
Supporter meant to bear or help.
Support meant to hold up and to help.

note.en: Support is compared with look-alike words and with verbs of helping.
note.cn: 把 support 与形近词以及表示帮助的动词作比较。

normalIntro.en: To support is to put your strength under someone else's weight.
normalIntro.cn: support 就是把自己的力量垫在别人的重量下面。

normal.en: Her family supported her decision.
The columns support the roof.
The bridge needs more support.
He supports a family of four.
Thank you for your strong support.

abstract.en: Support is strength lent to another.
abstract.cn: 支持，是借给别人的力量。

abstract.en: A roof forgets the columns that hold it.
abstract.cn: 屋顶会忘记托住它的柱子。

abstract.en: What we support, we help to stand.
abstract.cn: 我们支持什么，就是帮助什么站立。

examples.en: Her family supported her decision.
The columns support the roof.
He supports a family of four.

dict_mnemonic.text: support 是「支持、支撑」，也可指「供养」；supporter 是支持者，supportive 是支持的，financial support 是经济支持。

root: 来自拉丁语 supportare（从下面承载），由 sub（在下）与 portare（携带）组成，后引申为支持与供养。

sensesIntro.en: Support means to back someone, hold something up, provide for someone, or the help itself.
sensesIntro.cn: support 表示支持某人、支撑某物、供养某人，或指帮助本身。

core.en: Strength placed under a weight.

branches.en: Her family supported her decision.
branches.cn: 家人支持她的决定。

branches.en: The columns support the roof.
branches.cn: 这些柱子支撑着屋顶。

branches.en: The bridge needs more support.
branches.cn: 这座桥需要更多支撑。

branches.en: He supports a family of four.
branches.cn: 他供养四口之家。

branches.en: People and pillars both keep things standing.
branches.cn: 人和柱子都能让东西立住。

intro.en: Support builds supporter and supportive.
intro.cn: support 可构成 supporter 和 supportive。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin portare, to carry, with sub under.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是拉丁语 portare（携带），加上 sub（在下）。

latinEntries.example: Portare is the root of support.
latinEntries.exampleCN: portare 是 support 的词根。

latinEntries.example: Supportare led to French supporter.
latinEntries.exampleCN: supportare 演变为法语 supporter。

definition_en: a person who supports a person, group, or idea
core_image: 看台上举起围巾、为球队呐喊的人群
scene: 许多支持者在外面等候。Many supporters waited outside.
sceneCN: 这里 supporter 是「支持者」（第 1 个义项）；句意：许多支持者在外面等候。

senses.title: A person who backs something
senses.definition: someone who helps or agrees with a cause
senses.definitionCN: 帮助或赞同某项事业的人
senses.example: Many supporters waited outside.
senses.exampleCN: 许多支持者在外面等候。
senses.why: This is the general sense.

senses.title: A fan of a team
senses.definition: a fan who follows a sports team
senses.definitionCN: 追随某支运动队的粉丝
senses.example: He is a loyal supporter of the team.
senses.exampleCN: 他是这支球队的忠实球迷。
senses.why: This is the sports sense.

intro.en: Supporter is support plus -er, a person who supports.
intro.cn: supporter 是 support 加 -er，表示支持的人。

items.en: Supportare meant to carry from below.
Supporter meant to bear or help.
Supporter meant a person who helps.
It named backers of causes and teams.
items.cn: 它指事业与球队的支持者。

note.en: Supporter is compared with look-alike words and with words for fans and backers.
note.cn: 把 supporter 与形近词以及表示拥护者的词作比较。

entries.definition: a person who supports a plan
a person who speaks for a cause

normalIntro.en: A supporter is someone who stands behind you, not in front.
normalIntro.cn: 支持者站在你身后，而不是挡在你前面。

normal.en: Many supporters waited outside.
normal.cn: 许多支持者在外面等候。

normal.en: He is a loyal supporter of the team.
normal.cn: 他是这支球队的忠实球迷。

normal.en: The plan has few supporters.
normal.cn: 这个计划几乎没有支持者。

normal.en: Supporters cheered as the team scored.
normal.cn: 球队得分时球迷们欢呼。

normal.en: She is a strong supporter of the school.
normal.cn: 她是这所学校的坚定支持者。

abstract.en: A supporter lends belief when yours is thin.
abstract.cn: 支持者在你信心稀薄时借给你信念。

abstract.en: Every cause is carried by quiet supporters.
abstract.cn: 每项事业都由安静的支持者托起。

abstract.en: To support is to stand behind, not above.
abstract.cn: 支持，是站在身后，而不是站在头上。

examples.en: Many supporters waited outside.
examples.cn: 许多支持者在外面等候。

examples.en: He is a loyal supporter of the team.
examples.cn: 他是这支球队的忠实球迷。

examples.en: The plan has few supporters.
examples.cn: 这个计划几乎没有支持者。

dict_mnemonic.text: supporter 由 support（支持）加 -er（人）构成，表示支持者；在体育中还指某支球队的球迷。

root: support（支持）加表示人的后缀 -er，指提供支持的人。

sensesIntro.en: Supporter means a person who backs a cause or person, or a fan of a team.
sensesIntro.cn: supporter 表示支持某项事业或某个人的人，也可指球队的球迷。

core.en: A person who stands behind.

branches.en: Many supporters waited outside.
branches.cn: 许多支持者在外面等候。

branches.en: The plan has few supporters.
branches.cn: 这个计划几乎没有支持者。

branches.en: He is a loyal supporter of the team.
branches.cn: 他是这支球队的忠实球迷。

branches.en: A cause and a team both need supporters.
branches.cn: 事业和球队都需要支持者。

branches.en: Supporters cheered as the team scored.
branches.cn: 球队得分时球迷们欢呼。

intro.en: Supporter is support plus -er, inside the support family.
intro.cn: supporter 是 support 加 -er，属于 support 词族。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin portare, to carry.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根是拉丁语 portare，意为携带。

latinEntries.example: Supportare is the source of supporter.
latinEntries.exampleCN: supportare 是 supporter 的来源。

latinEntries.example: Portare lies behind supportare.
latinEntries.exampleCN: portare 是 supportare 的词根。

definition_en: to think that something is probably true, or to imagine it for an argument
core_image: 一个人闭上眼，据桌上的线索猜测答案
scene: 我猜他已经在路上了。I suppose he is already on his way.
sceneCN: 这里 suppose 是「猜想」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我猜他已经在路上了。

senses.title: To think probably
senses.definition: to think something is probably true
senses.definitionCN: 认为某事很可能是真的
senses.example: I suppose he is already on his way.
senses.why: This is the everyday sense.

senses.title: To imagine for argument
senses.definition: to imagine something as a starting point
senses.definitionCN: 把某事当作推理的起点
senses.example: Suppose you had one more day.
senses.why: Here the word sets up a condition.

senses.title: To be expected to
senses.definition: to be expected or required to do something
senses.definitionCN: 被期望或被要求做某事
senses.example: You are supposed to sign here.
senses.why: This is the fixed be supposed to pattern.
senses.whyCN: 这是 be supposed to 的固定用法。

intro.en: Suppose comes from Latin supponere, to put under.
intro.cn: suppose 来自拉丁语 supponere，意为放在下面。

items.en: Suppose meant to think or assume.

note.en: Suppose is compared with look-alike words and with verbs of assuming.
note.cn: 把 suppose 与形近词以及表示假定的动词作比较。

entries.definition: to take as true without proof
to form a picture in the mind

normalIntro.en: To suppose is to place an idea under a question and see if it holds.
normalIntro.cn: suppose 就是把一个想法放到问题下面，看它是否站得住。

normal.en: I suppose he is already on his way.
Suppose you had one more day.
You are supposed to sign here.
I suppose so, but I am not sure.
normal.cn: 我想是这样，但我不确定。

normal.en: Do you suppose she will come?

abstract.en: To suppose is to lend the mind a temporary truth.
abstract.cn: 猜想，是把一个临时的真相借给头脑。

abstract.en: Every science begins with suppose.
abstract.cn: 每一门科学都始于假设。

abstract.en: We suppose more often than we notice.
abstract.cn: 我们猜想的次数，比我们注意到的更多。

examples.en: I suppose he is already on his way.
Suppose you had one more day.
You are supposed to sign here.

dict_mnemonic.text: suppose 是「猜想、假设」，be supposed to 表示「应该」；I suppose so 是我想是这样。

root: 来自拉丁语 supponere（放在下面），由 sub（在下）与 ponere（放置）组成，意为把想法放在下面作为基础，即假设、猜想。

sensesIntro.en: Suppose means to think something is likely, to imagine a case, or in be supposed to, to be expected to.
sensesIntro.cn: suppose 表示认为某事很可能、设想一种情况，或在 be supposed to 中表示应该。

core.en: An idea placed under a question.
core.cn: 放在问题下面的一个想法。

branches.en: I suppose he is already on his way.
branches.cn: 我猜他已经在路上了。

branches.en: I suppose so, but I am not sure.
branches.cn: 我想是这样，但我不确定。

branches.en: Suppose you had one more day.
branches.cn: 假设你再多一天时间。

branches.en: You are supposed to sign here.
branches.cn: 你应该在这里签名。

branches.en: A guess today can become a premise tomorrow.
branches.cn: 今天的猜想，明天可能成为前提。

intro.en: Suppose builds supposed, supposedly, and supposition.
intro.cn: suppose 可构成 supposed、supposedly 和 supposition。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin ponere, to put.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根是拉丁语 ponere，意为放置。

items.example: The theory rests on a supposition.
items.exampleCN: 这个理论建立在一个假设上。

latinEntries.example: Supponere is the source of suppose.
latinEntries.exampleCN: supponere 是 suppose 的来源。

latinEntries.example: Ponere also gave English position.
latinEntries.exampleCN: ponere 也演变为英语的 position。

definition_en: highest in authority or importance
core_image: 法庭最高处的席位，俯视整个大厅
scene: 在这样的案件中，法院拥有最高权威。The court has supreme authority in such cases.
sceneCN: 这里 supreme 是「最高的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：在这样的案件中，法院拥有最高权威。

senses.title: Highest in authority
senses.definition: holding the highest power or rank
senses.example: The court has supreme authority in such cases.
senses.exampleCN: 在这样的案件中，法院拥有最高权威。
senses.why: This is the main political sense.

senses.title: Of the greatest degree
senses.definition: of the very greatest degree
senses.example: She showed supreme confidence.
senses.why: Here the word intensifies a quality.
senses.whyCN: 这里是在加强一种品质的程度。

intro.en: Supreme comes from Latin supremus, the highest.
intro.cn: supreme 来自拉丁语 supremus，意为最高的。

items.en: It also meant greatest in degree.

note.en: Supreme is compared with look-alike words and with words for the highest.
note.cn: 把 supreme 与形近词以及表示最高的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Supreme means nothing stands above it.
normalIntro.cn: supreme 意为再没有东西在它上面。

normal.en: The court has supreme authority in such cases.
normal.cn: 在这样的案件中，法院拥有最高权威。

normal.en: She showed supreme confidence.
The supreme commander gave the order.
normal.cn: 最高指挥官下达了命令。

normal.en: This issue is of supreme importance.
He made a supreme effort to finish.

abstract.en: Supreme is a height no ladder reaches.
abstract.cn: 至高，是梯子够不到的高度。

abstract.en: The highest power should be the most careful.
abstract.cn: 最高的权力，应当最为谨慎。

abstract.en: What is supreme in a life is often quiet.
abstract.cn: 生命里至高的东西，往往很安静。

examples.en: The court has supreme authority in such cases.
examples.cn: 在这样的案件中，法院拥有最高权威。

examples.en: She showed supreme confidence.
This issue is of supreme importance.

dict_mnemonic.text: supreme 是「最高的、至上的」，supreme court 是最高法院，supremacy 是至高权力，supremely 是极其。

root: 来自拉丁语 supremus（最高的），是 super（在上）的最高级形式，经法语进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Supreme means highest in authority, or greatest in degree.
sensesIntro.cn: supreme 表示权力或地位最高，也可表示程度达到极高。

core.en: The top, with nothing above.

branches.en: The court has supreme authority in such cases.
branches.cn: 在这样的案件中，法院拥有最高权威。

branches.en: The supreme commander gave the order.
branches.cn: 最高指挥官下达了命令。

branches.en: She showed supreme confidence.
branches.cn: 她表现出极强的自信。

branches.en: This issue is of supreme importance.
branches.cn: 这个问题至关重要。

branches.en: Power and degree can both reach the top.
branches.cn: 权力和程度都可以到达顶端。

intro.en: Supreme builds supremacy and supremely.
intro.cn: supreme 可构成 supremacy 和 supremely。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin supremus, highest.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根是拉丁语 supremus，意为最高的。

items.exampleCN: 这个团体信奉至上主义。
他们证明了自己的优越。

latinEntries.example: Supremus is the source of supreme.
latinEntries.exampleCN: supremus 是 supreme 的来源。

latinEntries.example: Super lies behind supremus.
latinEntries.exampleCN: super 是 supremus 的词根。

definition_en: certain that something is true or will happen
core_image: 一个人点头，把手放在心口表示确定
scene: 我确信自己锁了门。I am sure that I locked the door.
sceneCN: 这里 sure 是「确信的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我确信自己锁了门。

senses.title: Certain in your mind
senses.definition: feeling no doubt about something
senses.example: I am sure that I locked the door.
senses.why: This sense describes a person's confidence.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项描述人的把握。

senses.title: Certain to happen
senses.definition: certain to happen or be true
senses.definitionCN: 注定会发生或确实如此
senses.example: It is sure to rain tonight.
senses.why: Here the word describes the event.
senses.whyCN: 这里描述的是事情本身。

senses.title: Certainly, in speech
senses.definition: used in speech to mean certainly
senses.example: Sure, I can help you.
senses.why: This is the short spoken reply.

intro.en: Sure comes from Latin securus, free from care.
intro.cn: sure 来自拉丁语 securus，意为无忧的、安心的。

items.cn: seur 意为安全的、确定的。
sure 意为安全而确定的。

items.en: It became a spoken word for certainly.

note.en: Sure is compared with look-alike words and with words for certainty.
note.cn: 把 sure 与形近词以及表示确定的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Sure is a mind with no question left open.
normalIntro.cn: sure 是心里没有留下问题的状态。

normal.en: I am sure that I locked the door.
Make sure the window is closed.
It is sure to rain tonight.
Sure, I can help you.
Are you quite sure about the time?

abstract.en: Sure is a door closed quietly on doubt.
abstract.cn: 确定，是轻轻把怀疑关在门外。

abstract.en: Few things are as sure as we feel.
abstract.cn: 很少有事情像我们感觉的那样确定。

abstract.en: To be sure is to rest, if only for a moment.
abstract.cn: 确定，就是休息一下，哪怕只有片刻。

examples.en: I am sure that I locked the door.
Make sure the window is closed.
Sure, I can help you.

dict_mnemonic.text: sure 是「确信的、一定的」，make sure 是确保，for sure 是确实；口语中 sure 也可表示「当然」。

root: 来自拉丁语 securus（无忧的），经古法语 seur 进入英语，由「安心」引申为「确定」。

sensesIntro.en: Sure means feeling certain, certain to happen, or certainly in speech.
sensesIntro.cn: sure 表示心里确信、某事必然发生，或口语中的「当然」。

core.en: A mind at rest about the truth.

branches.en: I am sure that I locked the door.
branches.cn: 我确信自己锁了门。

branches.en: Are you quite sure about the time?
branches.cn: 你十分确定时间吗？

branches.en: It is sure to rain tonight.
branches.cn: 今晚一定会下雨。

branches.en: Sure, I can help you.
branches.cn: 当然，我可以帮你。

branches.en: People and events can both be sure.
branches.cn: 人和事都可以是确定的。

intro.en: Sure builds surely, surety, and assure.
intro.cn: sure 可构成 surely、surety 和 assure。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin securus, free from care.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根是拉丁语 securus，意为无忧的。

items.example: He was unsure of the way.
I assure you it is safe.
items.exampleCN: 我向你保证它是安全的。

latinEntries.example: Securus is the source of sure.
latinEntries.exampleCN: securus 是 sure 的来源。

latinEntries.example: Cura forms the second part of securus.
latinEntries.exampleCN: cura 是 securus 的第二个部分。

definition_en: certainly, or used to show surprise or disagreement
core_image: 一个人用力点头，表示毫无疑问
scene: 他一定会准时到达。He will surely arrive on time.
sceneCN: 这里 surely 是「确实、必定」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他一定会准时到达。

senses.title: Certainly
senses.definition: without doubt
senses.example: He will surely arrive on time.
senses.why: This is the core certainty sense.

senses.title: Used to challenge
senses.definition: used to show surprise or disagreement
senses.definitionCN: 用来表示惊讶或不赞同
senses.example: Surely you do not believe that.
senses.exampleCN: 你当然不会相信那个吧。
senses.why: Here the adverb pushes back on the listener.
senses.whyCN: 这里副词是在反问对方。

intro.en: Surely is sure plus the adverb ending -ly.
intro.cn: surely 是 sure 加上副词后缀 -ly。

items.en: It also became a word of challenge.
items.cn: 它也成为一种反问用语。

note.en: Surely is compared with look-alike words and with other adverbs of certainty.
note.cn: 把 surely 与形近词以及其他表示确定的副词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Surely means there is no reasonable doubt left.
normalIntro.cn: surely 意为再没有合理的怀疑留下。

normal.en: He will surely arrive on time.
Surely you do not believe that.
normal.cn: 你当然不会相信那个吧。

normal.en: Slowly but surely, the work got done.
normal.cn: 工作缓慢而稳步地完成了。

normal.en: Surely enough, the bus came at eight.
She is surely the best person for the job.
normal.cn: 她确实是这份工作的最佳人选。

abstract.en: Surely is confidence spoken aloud.
abstract.cn: 确实，是说出口的信心。

abstract.en: What is surely true needs no shouting.
abstract.cn: 确实为真的事，不需要大声喊。

abstract.en: Doubt asked a question; surely answered it.
abstract.cn: 怀疑提了一个问题，确实给了回答。

examples.en: He will surely arrive on time.
Slowly but surely, the work got done.
examples.cn: 工作缓慢而稳步地完成了。

examples.en: She is surely the best person for the job.
examples.cn: 她确实是这份工作的最佳人选。

dict_mnemonic.text: surely 由 sure（确信的）加 -ly 构成，表示确实、必定；slowly but surely 表示缓慢而稳步地。

root: sure（确信的）加副词后缀 -ly，表示确实无疑地。

sensesIntro.en: Surely means certainly, or serves to express surprise or disagreement.
sensesIntro.cn: surely 表示确实无疑，也可用来表示惊讶或不赞同。

core.en: Certainty spoken as an adverb.

branches.en: He will surely arrive on time.
branches.cn: 他一定会准时到达。

branches.en: Slowly but surely, the work got done.
branches.cn: 工作缓慢而稳步地完成了。

branches.en: Surely you do not believe that.
branches.cn: 你当然不会相信那个吧。

branches.en: Confidence and challenge share one adverb.
branches.cn: 确定与反问共用一个副词。

branches.en: She is surely the best person for the job.
branches.cn: 她确实是这份工作的最佳人选。

intro.en: Surely is sure plus -ly, inside the sure family.
intro.cn: surely 是 sure 加 -ly，属于 sure 词族。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin securus, free from care.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根是拉丁语 securus，意为无忧的。

items.example: He was unsure of the way.
I assure you it is safe.
items.exampleCN: 我向你保证它是安全的。

items.example: She spoke in an assured voice.
items.exampleCN: 她用有把握的声音说话。

latinEntries.example: Securus is the root of surely.
latinEntries.exampleCN: securus 是 surely 的词根。

latinEntries.example: Cura forms the second part of securus.
latinEntries.exampleCN: cura 是 securus 的第二个部分。

definition_en: the outside layer of something, or to come up to the top
core_image: 平静的水面映出天空，水下却看不见
scene: 桌面光滑而干净。The surface of the table was smooth and clean.
sceneCN: 这里 surface 是「表面」（第 1 个义项）；句意：桌面光滑而干净。

senses.title: The outer layer
senses.definition: the outside layer of an object
senses.example: The surface of the table was smooth and clean.
senses.why: This is the everyday physical sense.

senses.title: The top of water or land
senses.definition: the top level of water or the ground
senses.example: The submarine rose to the surface.
senses.why: Here the word names a boundary between levels.
senses.whyCN: 这里指不同层次之间的分界。

senses.title: To come into view
senses.definition: to rise to the top or become known
senses.example: New evidence surfaced last week.
senses.why: This is the figurative verb sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是比喻性的动词义项。

intro.en: Surface comes from French sur, above, and face, a face.
intro.cn: surface 来自法语 sur（在上）与 face（面）。

items.en: It became a verb meaning to appear.

note.en: Surface is compared with look-alike words and with words for the outside.
note.cn: 把 surface 与形近词以及表示外部的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: The surface is the face a thing turns toward the world.
normalIntro.cn: surface 是一样东西朝向世界的脸。

normal.en: The surface of the table was smooth and clean.
The submarine rose to the surface.
New evidence surfaced last week.
On the surface, the plan looks simple.
normal.cn: 表面上，这个计划看起来很简单。

normal.en: The earth's surface is mostly water.

abstract.en: The surface is honest and incomplete at once.
abstract.cn: 表面既真实，又同时不完整。

abstract.en: What floats to the surface was always there.
abstract.cn: 浮到表面的东西，一直都在那里。

abstract.en: Every surface hides a depth it cannot show.
abstract.cn: 每一个表面，都藏着它无法展示的深度。

examples.en: The surface of the table was smooth and clean.
The submarine rose to the surface.
New evidence surfaced last week.

dict_mnemonic.text: surface 是「表面」，也可指水面、地表；作动词表示浮现、显露；on the surface 表示表面上。

root: 来自法语 surface，由 sur（在上）与 face（面）组成，字面是「在上面的面」，即表面。

sensesIntro.en: Surface means the outside layer, the top of water or land, or to come into view.
sensesIntro.cn: surface 表示物体的外层、水面或地表，也可作动词表示浮现。

core.en: The outside face of a thing.

branches.en: The surface of the table was smooth and clean.
branches.cn: 桌面光滑而干净。

branches.en: The submarine rose to the surface.
branches.cn: 潜艇浮到水面。

branches.en: New evidence surfaced last week.
branches.cn: 上周出现了新证据。

branches.en: A face and an appearance share one word.
branches.cn: 表层与显现共用一个词。

branches.en: On the surface, the plan looks simple.
branches.cn: 表面上，这个计划看起来很简单。

intro.en: Surface builds superficial and surfacing.
intro.cn: surface 可构成 superficial 和 surfacing。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin facies, face, with super above.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是拉丁语 facies（面），加上 super（在上）。

items.meaning: the pull on a liquid surface

latinEntries.example: Facies is the second part of surface.
latinEntries.exampleCN: facies 是 surface 的第二个部分。

latinEntries.example: Super became sur in French.
latinEntries.exampleCN: super 在法语中变为 sur。

definition_en: a sudden large increase or forward movement
core_image: 海浪突然抬高，涌上堤岸
scene: 节日前电力需求猛增。There was a surge in demand for electricity before the holiday.
sceneCN: 这里 surge 是「激增」（第 1 个义项）；句意：节日前电力需求猛增。

senses.title: A sudden increase
senses.definition: a sudden large increase in amount
senses.example: There was a surge in demand for electricity before the holiday.
senses.why: This is the main modern sense.

senses.title: A swelling rush
senses.definition: a strong forward movement of water or feeling
senses.example: A surge of water hit the boat.
senses.why: Here the word is physical or emotional movement.
senses.whyCN: 这里指物理或情绪的涌动。

senses.title: To rise suddenly
senses.definition: to move forward or rise in a strong wave
senses.definitionCN: 以强烈的波浪向前或上升
senses.example: The crowd surged toward the gate.
senses.why: This is the verb sense.

intro.en: Surge comes from Latin surgere, to rise.
intro.cn: surge 来自拉丁语 surgere，意为升起。

items.en: It came to mean a sudden increase.

note.en: Surge is compared with look-alike words and with words for sudden increases.
note.cn: 把 surge 与形近词以及表示骤增的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: A surge is a wave that rises faster than expected.
normalIntro.cn: surge 是一道比预期涨得更快的浪。

normal.en: There was a surge in demand for electricity before the holiday.
A surge of water hit the boat.
The crowd surged toward the gate.
She felt a surge of anger.
A power surge damaged the computer.

abstract.en: A surge is a feeling that forgets the shore.
abstract.cn: 涌动，是一种忘了岸的情绪。

abstract.en: What rises fast may fall fast too.
abstract.cn: 涨得快的东西，也可能落得快。

abstract.en: Every wave is the sea practicing its voice.
abstract.cn: 每一道浪，都是海在练习自己的声音。

examples.en: There was a surge in demand for electricity before the holiday.
A surge of water hit the boat.
She felt a surge of anger.

dict_mnemonic.text: surge 表示数量「激增」或水、情绪的「汹涌」；a surge in demand 是需求激增，power surge 是电涌。

root: 来自拉丁语 surgere（升起），由 sub（从下）与 regere（引导）组成，原指水位上涨，后引申为激增。

sensesIntro.en: Surge means a sudden increase, a strong rush of water or feeling, or to rise and move in a wave.
sensesIntro.cn: surge 表示突然激增、水或情绪的强烈涌动，也可作动词表示涌起。

core.en: A force that rises and moves.
core.cn: 升起并向前移动的力量。

branches.en: There was a surge in demand for electricity before the holiday.
branches.cn: 节日前电力需求猛增。

branches.en: A surge of water hit the boat.
branches.cn: 一股水流冲击着小船。

branches.en: She felt a surge of anger.
branches.cn: 她感到一阵怒火。

branches.en: The crowd surged toward the gate.
branches.cn: 人群向大门涌去。

branches.en: Numbers and waves can both surge.
branches.cn: 数字和波浪都可以涌动。

intro.en: Surge builds surging, upsurge, and resurgent.
intro.cn: surge 可构成 surging、upsurge 和 resurgent。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin surgere, to rise.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根是拉丁语 surgere，意为升起。

items.exampleCN: 每年冬天需求都会激增。

items.example: There was an upsurge in interest.
The city saw a cultural resurgence.
items.exampleCN: 这座城市经历了文化复兴。

latinEntries.example: Surgere is the source of surge.
latinEntries.exampleCN: surgere 是 surge 的来源。

latinEntries.example: Regere forms part of surgere.
latinEntries.exampleCN: regere 是 surgere 的组成部分。

definition_en: medical treatment in which a doctor cuts into the body
core_image: 无影灯下，医生戴着口罩专注操作
scene: 他需要做膝盖手术。He needs surgery on his knee.
sceneCN: 这里 surgery 是「外科手术」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他需要做膝盖手术。

senses.title: Medical operation
senses.definition: treatment by cutting into the body
senses.definitionCN: 通过切开身体进行的治疗
senses.example: He needs surgery on his knee.
senses.why: This is the main medical sense.

senses.title: A doctor's office
senses.definition: a place where a doctor sees patients, in British use
senses.definitionCN: 英式英语中医生看诊的地方
senses.example: The surgery opens at nine.
senses.why: This is a British place sense.

senses.title: The branch of medicine
senses.definition: the field of medicine that uses operations
senses.definitionCN: 以手术为手段的医学分支
senses.example: She teaches surgery at the university.
senses.why: Here the word names a discipline.

intro.en: Surgery comes from Greek cheirourgia, hand work.
intro.cn: surgery 来自希腊语 cheirourgia，意为手工操作。

items.en: Cheirourgia meant hand work, especially healing.
items.cn: cheirourgia 意为手工操作，尤指治疗。

note.en: Surgery is compared with look-alike words and with words for medical treatment.
note.cn: 把 surgery 与形近词以及表示医疗的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Surgery is healing done with careful hands.
normalIntro.cn: surgery 是用一双谨慎的手完成的治疗。

normal.en: He needs surgery on his knee.
She had heart surgery last year.
The surgery opens at nine.
He is recovering from surgery.
Plastic surgery is common in some cities.
normal.cn: 整形手术在一些城市很常见。

abstract.en: Surgery is trust placed in steady hands.
abstract.cn: 手术，是把信任交给一双稳当的手。

abstract.en: The body can be repaired and also remembers.
abstract.cn: 身体可以被修复，也会记得。

abstract.en: Healing begins before the wound closes.
abstract.cn: 愈合，在伤口合上之前就开始了。

examples.en: He needs surgery on his knee.
She had heart surgery last year.
He is recovering from surgery.

dict_mnemonic.text: surgery 是「外科手术」，英式英语中也可指「诊所」；surgeon 是外科医生，surgical 是外科的。

root: 来自希腊语 cheirourgia（手工操作），由 cheir（手）与 ergon（工作）组成，经拉丁语与古法语进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Surgery means a medical operation, a doctor's office in British use, or the field of operative medicine.
sensesIntro.cn: surgery 表示外科手术、英式英语中的诊所，或外科这一学科。

core.en: Healing through careful handwork.
core.cn: 通过谨慎的手工操作来治疗。

branches.en: He needs surgery on his knee.
branches.cn: 他需要做膝盖手术。

branches.en: She had heart surgery last year.
branches.cn: 她去年做了心脏手术。

branches.en: The surgery opens at nine.
branches.cn: 诊所九点开门。

branches.en: She teaches surgery at the university.
branches.cn: 她在大学教外科。

branches.en: An operation and a discipline share one name.
branches.cn: 手术与学科共用一个名字。

intro.en: Surgery builds surgeon, surgical, and surgically.
intro.cn: surgery 可构成 surgeon、surgical 和 surgically。

latinIntro.en: The base is Greek cheirourgia, hand work.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根是希腊语 cheirourgia，意为手工操作。

items.exampleCN: 两名外科医生加入了团队。

latinEntries.example: Cheir is the first element of surgery.
latinEntries.exampleCN: cheir 是 surgery 的第一个成分。

latinEntries.example: Ergon also gave English energy.
latinEntries.exampleCN: ergon 也演变为英语的 energy。

latinEntries.example: Chirurgia led to French surgerie.
latinEntries.exampleCN: chirurgia 演变为法语 surgerie。
